Stanbic IBTC Imaan Fund

Highlights
  • The Stanbic IBTC Imaan Fund (SIMAAN) was launched in October 2013
  • The Fund invests a minimum of 70% of its portfolio in shari'ah-compliant equities and a maximum of 30% in other shariah-compliant assets such as Sukuk 
  • The Fund has no minimum holding period and no penal charge
  • The minimum investment amount is N5,000.00 
  • It is an open-ended fund
  • The risk profile for the Fund is “Aggressive”
  • The Management fee of the fund  is 1.5% per annum
